name: Villa La Massa
insider_take: This 16th-century Medici villa along the Arno River feels like stepping into Renaissance royalty, just 10 minutes from Florence's heart.
whats_special: Villa La Massa sits on the same grounds where the powerful Medici family once entertained nobility. The hotel's private boat shuttle to Florence follows the historic route used by Renaissance merchants, offering stunning views of ancient stone bridges and riverside palazzos that most tourists never see.
pro_tip: Book the Medici Suite in the original villa - it features frescoed ceilings from the 1500s and overlooks the exact Arno bend where Lorenzo de' Medici once hosted lavish garden parties.
dont_miss: The hotel's private riverside terrace at sunset, where you can sip Chianti while watching rowing crews glide past - it's the same view that inspired countless Renaissance painters, and you'll understand why Florence became the cradle of artistic genius.
pros: Historic Renaissance villa with authentic Florentine charm
Picturesque Arno River setting with beautiful gardens
Close proximity to Florence city center attractions
